shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch; sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; tail -80 src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; ls -a | rg 'prettier|AGENTS'"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts')
s = p.read_text()
start = s.index('function errorForHook(')
end = s.index('\\nexport interface OrchestratorHooks', start)
block = s[start:end]
s = s[:start] + s[end+1:]
pos = s.index('// A throwing policy')
s = s[:pos] + block + '\\n\\n' + s[pos:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('.lore/dod.md')
s = p.read_text().replace('## Facets\\n', '## Facets\\n\\n- [x] Move "'`errorForHook` below its caller to address the CI lint finding.'"\\n', 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md
git add src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts .lore/dod.md
git commit -m 'Move error helper below orchestrator'
git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main
git status --short --branch"
